The opportunity

A drug-free treatment pathway your clinic can offer

MoreNova's low-intensity shockwave therapy addresses the underlying vascular mechanism — painless, non-invasive and drug-free — a clinically studied option your clinic can offer alongside existing ED care.

Treat the cause, not the calendar

Low-intensity shockwave therapy promotes angiogenesis and neovascularisation — improving penile blood flow and supporting the return of spontaneous, stronger erections over time, without medication or invasive procedures.

A discreet, dignified experience

The hands-free protocol matters in men's health: once the applicator is positioned and locked, treatment runs without continuous operator contact — a more comfortable experience for a sensitive consultation.

A service line, not a single treatment

One platform covers erectile dysfunction, Peyronie's disease and lower urinary tract symptoms — three indications your clinic can build a men's health programme around.

The science

Mechanically triggered. Biologically delivered.

Low-intensity shockwave therapy (LiSWT) applies precise acoustic energy to tissue. Numerous studies have demonstrated its effectiveness at inducing angiogenesis, generating new tissue growth and significantly improving haemodynamics.

Acoustic pulseThousands of low-intensity pulses per session reach the target tissue
Mechanical shear stressEndothelial cells lining the blood vessels register the microstress signal
Growth-factor releaseVEGF production peaks at the optimal energy density of ~0.09 mJ/mm²
AngiogenesisNew blood vessels form; stem and progenitor cells are activated in situ
Improved haemodynamicsBetter perfusion supports the return of natural erectile function

Mechanism validated across in vitro and in vivo models, including activation of penile progenitor cells demonstrated at UCSF — see the evidence below.

The technology

Not another radial device. A different physics.

Radial-wave devices produce conventional sound waves with slow rise times — they do not create true shockwaves, do not produce angiogenesis and do not activate progenitor cells. MoreNova generates focused low-intensity shockwaves, and delivers them in a way no point-focused system can.

VS
Conventional

Point-focused systems

Energy concentrates on a single point. The operator repositions the probe, application after application, across the treatment area.

  • One point treated at a time
  • Consistency depends on the operator's hand
  • More applications to cover the same area
MoreNova

Linear Shockwave Technology

Energy distributes evenly across an elongated tissue segment — and because the transducer can be positioned and locked, the protocol runs hands-free.

  • Covers the whole tissue segment in one application
  • Positioned and locked — runs hands-free, operator-independent
  • Fewer applications and fewer sessions to clinical results

Linear — double 50 mm transducer

Treats elongated tissue segments in a single application — the technology behind the world's only hands-free ED protocol.

Deep Focus — energy at organ depth

Precise control over penetration depth enables effective application of shockwave energy to the whole prostate and large portions of pelvic floor tissue.

Focused — 15 mm transducer

Concentrated energy for small, well-defined targets such as the fibrotic plaques of Peyronie's disease.

Clinical applications

Three indications. One men's health platform.

The Men's Health configuration includes dedicated transducers developed for three indications — each with pre-programmed, customised protocols.

Erectile dysfunction

Restore spontaneity, drug-free

MoreNova enhances erectile function by improving blood flow and promoting neovascularisation — helping restore spontaneous, stronger erections over time. The Linear protocol is fully hands-free.

6 sessionsApprox. 3 weeks3,000 pulses / sessionHands-free
Peyronie's disease

Target the plaque directly

Focused 15 mm energy delivery increases blood circulation and promotes tissue elasticity. Used alongside other treatments, it may reduce curvature and improve penile function — naturally and without pain.

6–8 sessionsFocused 15 mmAdjunctive therapy
LUTS & chronic pelvic pain

Reach the prostate, non-invasively

Deep Focus capability applies energy to the prostate and pelvic floor, improving microcirculation, relaxing chronically tense pelvic muscles and reducing inflammation — a non-invasive, dignified option for persistent pelvic symptoms.

6–8 sessions3–4 weeksCircular 30 mm

Hands-free workflow

Position. Lock. Let it run.

Because Linear technology treats a large tissue area in a single application, the transducer can be positioned and locked in place — changing the experience for patients and clinicians alike.

1

Position & lock

The clinician positions the linear applicator and locks it in place. Pre-programmed protocols are selected on the touchscreen — no manual parameter work.

2

Treatment runs hands-free

The system delivers the full application without continuous operator contact — consistent, operator-independent energy delivery, every session.

3

Patient walks out

Painless treatment, no anaesthesia, no recovery time. Patients resume normal activities immediately — a 20–30 minute visit, start to finish.
